predictions.articleTitle: FC Cincinnati vs DC United Prediction: Defensive Fragility Meets High xG — Scoreline & Model Preview
predictions.coreRecommendation: FC Cincinnati to secure a vital home victory at TQL Stadium as elite chance creation from Kévin Denkey and Evander overcomes defensive vulnerabilities against a road-weary DC United backline.
possibilityAssessment: Primary Thesis: FC Cincinnati to win at home, exploiting DC United's leaky road defense (Confidence: Moderate, Value: High)
Secondary Angle: Over 2.5 Total Goals as both porous backlines concede high xG (Confidence: High, Value: High)
Contingency Angle: High-scoring stalemate hedge if Cincinnati's defensive lapses persist (Confidence: Low, Value: Moderate)

bet_recommendations.match_highlight: Denkey and Evander drive Cincinnati playoff push against road-fragile DC United

spf.comment: Cincinnati's 1.92 xG home attacking output and the Denkey-Evander tandem will outscore their defensive concessions against a DC United unit that conceded eight goals in their last two away matches.

over_under.comment: Cincinnati's 70 goals conceded combined with a 1.92 xG average supports a high-scoring encounter exceeding 2.5 goals.

score.comment: A 2:1 home victory represents the primary convergence of both attacks, with 3:1 offering a second-half transition expansion.
